abstract.t: This document describes an RDAP extension that allows RDAP clients to request to be redirected to a related RDAP record for a resource, and an RDAP extension that gives RDAP clients the ability to request no redirection in other scenarios. This document also defines new link relations that can be used in redirect requests that can be used in query bootstrapping and navigating hierarchies, such as the hierarchies described in RFC 9910.
